rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: At the sitting of 24 April 1998 (agenda item 5, chaired by Г.Н.Селезнев), A. A. Kotenkov, the President's plenipotentiary representative in the State Duma, states that, the Duma having rejected the candidacy presented for consent, the President under Article 111(3) of the Constitution has submitted for the Duma's consent the candidacy of Kiriyenko Sergei Vladilenovich ('внес на рассмотрение Государственной Думы ... кандидатуру Кириенко Сергея Владиленовича'), and on the President's instruction presents him.
rows.locator: Morning session, agenda item 5: statement of Котенков А.А.

rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: The Counting Commission's chairman И. М. Братищев reads protocol No. 4 on the secret ballot on consent to the appointment of Kiriyenko Sergei Vladilenovich as Chairman of the Government, 24 April 1998: 450 deputies in all, 315 received ballots, 276 ballots found in the boxes, none invalid; 'за - 251, против - 25'; the candidacy received a majority of the total number of deputies. The Duma approves protocol No. 4 (16:09:29: 342 for, 9 against, 1 abstention, 'Результат: принято').
rows.locator: Afternoon: report of Братищев И.М. on protocol No. 4; 'Результаты голосования (16 час. 09 мин. 29 сек.)'
